Justice is a representation of order.
Saving one and saving all are two different things.
The more you strive for proper salvation,
the more you'll be consumed by your own contradiction.
You'll end up a simple killer for hire!
If you're unable to see that, then die.
Be smashed to pieces, along with your ideals!
Burn out before you can achieve anything!
Yes, if that happened, my erroneous existence would vanish like mist.

Why am I even bothering to fight him fairly?
If I took a few steps back, this would all be over.
But something tells me that if I took even one step back,
it would mean admitting my defeat in a crucial aspect!
No, this is all but over.
He's already dead on his feet.
Am I stupid? How many times will I seemingly land the final blow before I learn my lesson?
He's long since gone past it.
And that's because the thing he's attempting to cut down stopped being me long ago.
I know that haggard look all too well!
the man with an indomitable spirit who was never defeated, who never gave up.
The cruel embodiment of justice who struggled toward his ideal of saving all, even as it was shared by none...
I know that ugly sight all too well!
The idea that perhaps it is possible to save all who suffer...
I know that sinful manner of living all too well!
What Shirou is trying to cut down is the self that stands in his way.

To remain true to what he's believed in—
what he will continue believing in.
What Archer is trying to kill is the self that gave rise to him.
To wipe out the mistakes he is doomed to repeat in the future.
It's just that the outcome was not what they wished for.
Even if nothing but regrets remained,
if they were able to achieve many of their ideals in the process, then...
That figure, knowing he cannot win, knowing it is meaningless,
yet continuing to fight all the same...
That symbolizes the very mistakes I made.
No, the result will be the same.
You'll lose all hope, just as I have!
Your mana gave out before your spirit did?
That blade is the only weapon left to you.
In any event, Emiya Shirou's battle ends here!
I understand that putting others before myself is hypocritical.
Even so, the thought of being able to live like that inspired me.
Even if my life is a sham,
the wish for others to be happy is still beautiful.
Even if I'm being foolish, I won't turn back.
Even if I'm a fake to the very end,
I know my dream isn't a mistake!
I'm being made to look into an old mirror.
There really was such a man once, wasn't there?
Archer, how did you get hurt like that?
Sentimental to the core, I see.
If this girl had just been a little more callous, I never would have reverted to my old self.
In any case, the matter's been settled.
Now that I've accepted you, the hero Emiya can no longer stay here.
The defeated should take their leave at once.
A truly pointless fight between two fakes.
How long has it been, Saber? Ten years?

So, do you finally comprehend the difference 
between your imitations and the genuine article?

No matter how closely you copy the shape or power, 
an imitation will never shine as brightly as the original.
The mere sight of fakes crafted by fakes sullies my eyes.

Shams who do naught but copy others 
should return to the dust whence they came.
I'm surprised he had it in him to save another.
Who gave you permission to lay a hand on my Archer?
I intended to start with that walking corpse,
but I see the order has changed, woman.
What are you doing here, Archer?
Following the conclusion of the previous War,
I remained in this world instead of disappearing.
I had unfinished business, you see.
Servants should lose their anchor to this world
You could not possibly have remained here for 10 years.
Even after the Grail has disappeared,
if a mage continues to supply us with mana,
it is possible to remain here.
Of course, without the Grails assistance,
that means a vast amount of mana is required.
Well, there are any number of methods.
You can't seriously mean, your Master...

It is the way of the world to steal from others
what one cannot provide for oneself.
it was not necessary to go to such lengths.
As the only Servant who bathed in the Grail,
I took physical form in this era ten years ago.
Yes, I have you to thank, Saber.
I know its true nature better than anyone.
As its innards poured out upon me, I saw what lay within it.
In that instant, I made a decision:
that none but I would wield it.
The ritual to summon the Grail is a twisted joke.
A life-or-death struggle among seven Masters?
A ritual wherein only the last Master standing wins the Grail?
The Grail has been here the whole time.
Each time, the mages first prepare the Grail,
Do you see, King of Knights?
What they wanted was not the Grail but its contents.
While those mages did indeed create the Grail,
they were unable to fill it.
And so, they summoned the contents—
You're quick on the uptake, Tohsaka wench.
The Grail must be filled with mana of the highest purity.
And so, humanity's mightiest souls—its guardians, one might say—
were the very contents they sought!
If the souls of six Servants were fed into it,
After all, to the mages, it would be a source of inexhaustible mana.
Then only a Master can wield the Grail.
If, as you say, the Grail is a repository of pure mana,
then only a mage can use it.
But I have no interest in such things.
Only in the Grail's ability to act as a hole.
When I was but a step away from claiming the Grail,
The Grail was cut in two by a holy sword.
What spilled forth became a great inferno that seared the city.

I was directly beneath it, so naturally, 
my body was drenched in the deluge.
In that moment, I learned the Grail's real nature.
In truth, it is a joke.
But even so, it has its uses.

Of all the weapons in the world, 
there is none so perfectly tailored to killing.
You say that the Grail, something brought into being by Servants, is a weapon?
By our nature, we ourselves are weapons.
The Grail merely takes that nature to its logical conclusion.
The Holy Grail is a gateway to Hell.
When it is opened, billions of curses will pour out.
That it was a Grail that had already been corrupted?
A chalice of greed that you humans dragged down to Earth?
That it is one of humanity's great evils,
tailored to cursing and killing humans?
Then what you are after is humanity's...
Yes, the eradication of all humans in this era.
This world is enjoyable, but it is also beyond redemption.
A plenitude of mongrels enjoying life is an affront to the king.
Wh-What do you mean, an affront to the king?
What's the point of being king with no one to rule over?
If they die out, so be it.

Those who vanish as a consequence of 
their own sin cannot possibly be of value.
It is not mongrels that I desire.
It is those who can survive, even in the fires of Hell,
who are worthy of my rule.
In that respect, those who died last time were failures.
If a little fire like that is enough to kill them,
the humans of this time are far too frail.
I do not know what those who created the Grail intended,
but it is a convenient tool.
A death sentence that will fall equally on all humans.
A fathomless darkness, created by man, that kills only man.
A hound worthy of being delegated this task of mine.
So let us pick up where we left off ten years ago.
Back then, a filthy mongrel interrupted us,
but now, there is no such mongrel present.
Admittedly, an even more inferior fake is in our presence.
I have slain my true target.
That shall be enough for today.
After all, I've collected a troubling amount of soot.
Take heed: your lives are worth less to me than soot.
You have no time to waste, however.
I shall produce the Grail right away and open a hole leading to Hell.
Saber, if you wish to recover it, act swiftly.
This time, the Grail is a hasty affair, riddled with defects.
or its contents will drain out completely.
Everyone keeps getting in my way!
I see you have joined the fray, Shinji.
Whose fault do you think that is?
I got stabbed by Lancer thanks to your incompetence!
So that is why that girl was still alive.
Tohsaka slipped through my fingers because you and that priest are such worthless scum!
You bet your ass it is!
Didn't you say that we couldn't get the Grail without Tohsaka?
The priest said that even if you have the Grail, you need a vessel.
He said it wouldn't work unless you had someone for a sacrifice!
We have another Master right here who can serve as a vessel, correct?
You desire the Grail, do you not?
Then I shall give it to you.
One should keep one's prized possessions close by at all times.
Still, something ugly should best bring out the flavor.
And most of all, a man of your character should belch forth fine mud indeed.
It hurts... It hurts... It hurts!
